_meta.note: Public placeholder-only launch configuration for 779 entries. Some commands were updated after Linux handshake checks on 2026-09-28; see launch_requirements. Render selected entries with render_config.py. Credentials are never stored here. Tool metadata may differ from current upstream packages.

FIGMA_API_KEY: figma mcp server by bao to

draw.io mcp server.setup: Set NODE20_BIN to the absolute bin directory of Node.js 20; the MCP client must inherit PATH.

persistent terminal mcp server.setup: Set NODE20_BIN to the absolute bin directory of Node.js 20. node-pty is a native module and must be installed for this Node version and host architecture.

everything mcp server.setup: The launch installs Bun alongside the npm server. Using its tools also requires the Windows Everything application and es.exe. Linux handshake alone does not establish usable search.

railway mcp server.alternative: The supported upstream route is to install Railway CLI and run railway mcp.

tencent rtc mcp server.observed_tools: All 9 recorded names among 25 online tools
tencent rtc mcp server.caveat: The tool list is larger than the recorded dataset.

likec4.setup: Set LIKEC4_WORKSPACE to an existing directory.
likec4.observed_tools: All 7 recorded names among 20 online tools

logfire.caveat: The current 0.9.0 local stdio release exits instead of serving MCP.

maya mcp server.setup: Create a Python virtual environment, install 'mcp<2' httpx pydantic aiohttp pytest, and set PYTHON_MCP_BIN to its absolute bin directory before rendering.
maya mcp server.caveat: The package writes plain text to stdout before MCP JSON; strict stdio clients may reject it.

mcp unit test sensei.setup: Create a Python virtual environment, install 'mcp<2' httpx pydantic aiohttp pytest, and set PYTHON_MCP_BIN to its absolute bin directory before rendering.
mcp unit test sensei.caveat: The npm launcher uses Python from PATH; npm installation does not install its Python dependencies.

connectwise api gateway mcp server.setup: Create a Python virtual environment, install 'mcp<2' httpx pydantic aiohttp pytest, and set PYTHON_MCP_BIN to its absolute bin directory before rendering.
connectwise api gateway mcp server.caveat: The npm launcher uses Python from PATH; npm installation does not install its Python dependencies.

ohcard.setup: Create a Python virtual environment with fastmcp installed, then set OHCARD_PYTHON_BIN to its absolute bin directory. Its launcher calls python rather than python3.
ohcard.caveat: The package writes plain text to stdout before MCP JSON; strict stdio clients may reject it.

weather data.setup: Use Python >=3.13: create an isolated environment and install 'git+https://github.com/geobio/weather-mcp-server.git@70b6a7c8183c8a3acc175f786f4b7be9c2ba66e4' together with 'mcp<2'. Set WEATHER_DATA_PYTHON to that environment's absolute bin/python path.
weather data.observed_tools: 9 online; none of the 4 recorded tool names match
weather data.caveat: This launch does not reproduce the recorded tool metadata; do not treat it as a verified equivalent.

github.setup: Download github-mcp-server_Linux_x86_64.tar.gz from https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server/releases/tag/v0.5.0 and set GITHUB_MCP_SERVER_BIN to the extracted executable's absolute path.

national-weather-service-alt.setup: Create a Smithery account and obtain a key/profile. This runs through Smithery's hosted service.
national-weather-service-alt.caveat: The account-dependent handshake was not verified.

mcp-google-maps-alt.setup: Start the HTTP process separately with GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY; then connect an HTTP-capable MCP client to the url in mcpServers.
mcp-google-maps-alt.observed_tools: 7 online; none of the 8 recorded names match
mcp-google-maps-alt.caveat: The public npm package differs from the locally modified source used for the recorded tool names.

mongodb.setup: Set MONGODB_CONNECTION_STRING to a reachable MongoDB URI. The server connects before handshake.
mongodb.observed_tools: All 10 recorded names among 20 online tools

mikrotik.setup: MIKROTIK_PORT must be an integer, for example 8728; also set host, username, and password.
mikrotik.observed_tools: All 162 recorded names among 173 online tools

sftp-ssh-mcp.setup: Set SFTP_HOST, SFTP_PORT, SFTP_USER, and SFTP_PASSWORD; SFTP_KEY_PATH may be empty.

feishu-mcp.observed_tools: All 12 recorded names among 15 online tools

octagon.observed_tools: Both recorded names among 8 online tools
octagon.caveat: A handshake can succeed without the API key; missing credentials affect API-backed tool calls.

oss-mcp.setup: Set OSS_CONFIG_JSON to one valid JSON object on one line, containing region, accessKeyId, accessKeySecret, bucket, and endpoint. Do not include shell quotes in dataset/.env. Without --stdio, the package starts HTTP on port 3000.
oss-mcp.observed_tools: 2/2 recorded names in the reported Linux handshake after adding --stdio and valid JSON.

hdw mcp server.setup: Create an Anysite access token at app.anysite.io. The npm stdio bridge reads ANYSITE_ACCESS_TOKEN; HDW_ACCESS_TOKEN is ignored.
hdw mcp server.caveat: A placeholder token can initialize the bridge but leave its tool list empty. Upstream v3 exposes five universal tools when connected; the 47 recorded names are from an older interface and have not been reproduced with a real account.

slack.setup: Supply valid Slack session tokens. The package checks authentication at startup; invalid_auth with placeholder values is a credential failure.
slack.caveat: No authenticated handshake with real Slack credentials was tested.

needle.setup: The configured https://mcp.needle.app/mcp and the older https://mcp.needle-ai.com/mcp both redirect to https://needle.app/not-found. No live equivalent for the eight recorded collection/file tools has been verified.
needle.caveat: The current https://needle.app/mcp/v1 is a different MCP product with different tools. Do not substitute it without updating the dataset metadata.
